name: transition_field
summary: The measurement-first inverse of forward_projector. For each chain event with (position, frame, value), measure gradients across a 4D aperture (spatial sphere × temporal disk). Outputs Transition (per-pair delta) + TransitionField (aggregate: divergence, curl, mean_velocity, flow_signature). The flow_signature is a 64-d DCT — joins the wave axis directly. When the chain has data, MEASURE. When it doesn't, fall back to forward_projector.
engine_pattern: deterministic gradient measurement. Pure-Python vector math. Same DCT-II as tri_modal_embedder and svg_vector_embed so signatures join across the same unit hypersphere.

the_architectural_inversion.before: chain event → forward_projector → LLM extrapolation (cost ~10s, best-effort determinism)
the_architectural_inversion.after: chain event → measure transitions in aperture → flow signature (cost <50ms, bytes-exact)
the_architectural_inversion.forward_projector_role: fallback when chain is SPARSE — no nearby events to measure
the_architectural_inversion.transition_field_role: default when chain is DENSE — events exist within (radius, frame_window)

substrate: in-memory Transition + TransitionField objects (caller persists via inference_logger)

measurement_aperture.spatial: sphere of radius_m around query position (default 5m)
measurement_aperture.temporal: ±frame_window frames around query frame at given fps (default ±30 @ 60fps = 0.5s)

computed_quantities.mean_velocity_vec: average velocity vector across all transitions in field
computed_quantities.divergence: sum of (direction · outward) — flow outward (source) or inward (sink)
computed_quantities.flow_signature: DCT-II of velocity magnitudes, L2-normed → joins wave axis

inbound_callers: svg_vector_embed (shape morph: square → blue square as measured transition)

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.single_transition: ev_A→ev_B: spatial 1m, velocity 12 m/s, color_velocity 3.39 units/s, crystal stable
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.field_3_transitions: divergence=+18 (outward flow), curl=(0,0,0) (no rotation), flow_sig norm=1.0
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.find_similar_flows: self sim=1.000, alt-anchor sim=0.7606 (similar flow pattern at different position)

why_flow_sig_is_first_class: Same 64-d DCT-II shape + L2 norm as wave_embedding (text), svg_path_embedding (geometry), room_signature (acoustic), sentence_chain (syntactic). One unit hypersphere; one cosine_similarity function; one universe of retrieval.
guarantees: Deterministic — same inputs → same transition + field crystal byte-exact
Pure measurement — no LLM, no model load, no prediction noise
Lossless within aperture — every event in (radius, frame_window) gets measured
Joinable — flow_signature lives on the same hypersphere as wave/svg/sentence axes
Composable — Transition crystals can themselves be chained (Transition of Transitions)
usage_example:
from transition_field import Transition, TransitionField
t = Transition.measure(src_event, dst_event, fps=60, value_key='rgb')
field = TransitionField.measure(query=src_event, corpus=events, radius_m=5.0, frame_window=30, fps=60, value_key='rgb')
print(field.divergence, field.curl_vec, field.flow_signature[:8])
